## Reconcile: all three stages are done, so the next step is the completion review

**What I found**

- **Stages 1–3 are all ticked and stamped COMPLETE.** The stamps are authoritative, so I made no fuzzy match against `specs/plans/completed/`.
- **Stage 3 (plan 5) is the only stamp the last resume hadn't seen.** That resume was on 2026-10-09; plan 5 was stamped on 2026-11-04.
- **Plan 5's Handoff reads `None`.** It changes nothing, and I have nothing to amend or commit. Its stamp correctly leaves out the "Its Handoff section names…" sentence.
- **No stages remain unticked and the roadmap has no Ranked list.** So no stage needs to be handed off or re-ranked.

That takes us to the roadmap-completion review: a conformance audit of the whole system before the roadmap can retire. This is not a code-diff review, because each stage's code was reviewed when it merged.

**Audit: re-run the gap rubric over R1–R6 with evidence for each verdict**

These are the read-only calls I'm making next:

```
Read  specs/parking-occupancy-spec.md                         # §2–§4, R1–R6 wording
Read  specs/plans/completed/2-sensor-ingest.md                # R1–R3: tasks, tests, any "> Deviation:" notes
Read  specs/plans/completed/3-occupancy-rates.md              # R4
Read  specs/plans/completed/5-occupancy-dashboard.md          # R5, R6 (Handoff already read)
Read  specs/deferred_items.md                                 # unticked items tied to R1–R6, if the file exists
Grep  "15|5 \* 60|interval|schedule" in sensors/              # R3: confirm the poll interval moved from 15 to 5 min (sensors/poll.py:18)
Grep  "bay_events|occupancy|0\.95|95" across the repo          # path:line evidence for R1, R2, R4–R6
Glob  tests/**/*.py                                           # the test names behind each Exit (duplicate-event, hand-count, 95% alert)
```

**R3 needs the closest look.** The original table filed it as *implemented-differently*: the code polled every 15 minutes, but §2 asks for 5. If the interval is still 15 minutes and no `> Deviation:` note in plan 2 records why, R3 is unmet.

**What happens with the results**

- **Every row is implemented-as-specified, or differs with a recorded deviation.** I'll ask you to approve retiring the roadmap. The roadmap would move to `specs/completed/` beside the spec.
- **Any row is unmet.** I'll put each one to you as one question with two options: add it as a new stage (the roadmap stays live), or defer it consciously with a written reason.

Optionally, once the audit is done, Describe mode in describe-critique-methodology can re-derive the system independently. That would be the input to a next critique round.
